discrepancies.summary: No reproducible main-project build or run configuration.
user-creator batch scripts contain machine-specific Windows paths.
Stale compiled classes exist beside source files, including classes without Java sources.
plan_storeSessions_fix.md describes a fix already present in PomodoroView.complete().
Guest users can reach the Users tab and retain add/delete controls.
Task completion does not update the assigned user's completion counter.
Priority ordering and urgent-incomplete filtering contradict their comments.
Task.completedAt is displayed but not serialized by JsonStorage.
JsonStorage has shared mutable state and session-history round-trip gaps.
storeSessions filtering is incomplete in timer and report aggregates.
Settings validation and management policy controls are not enforced.
Main startup duplicates the PostgreSQL merge and exit persistence path.
Legacy and runtime data files have unclear ownership; DUMMY data is present.
Runtime resources depend on the process working directory.
Dead APIs, unused UI fields, missing source files, and a stale backup remain.

decisions: Treat Java source as authoritative and compiled classes as build artifacts.
Treat the main application and user-creator utility as separate runtime products.
Describe PostgreSQL as an optional user-registry source with JSON fallback.
Document the workspace as a source snapshot rather than a self-contained runnable project.
Enforce storeSessions consistently across service queries, UI displays, and persistence.
Address persistence, migration, guest authorization, and resource-loading gaps before production use.
open_actions: Add a portable build/run configuration and dependency setup instructions.
Remove stale class files and the UserView backup from source-controlled paths.
Add JsonStorage, migration, DAO, and JavaFX integration tests.
Clarify guest permissions and persist task completion metadata.
Make storeSessions filtering consistent in aggregate services.
Move icon and notification resources to classpath resources or define a stable working-directory contract.
